description: Two-panel graphic pairing a screenshot of a verified James Comey tweet praising Andrew McCabe on his departure with a screenshot of Q drop No.80 (01/29/18), which offers a 'JC Tweet Translation' inserting bracketed claims that recast each phrase of the tweet as coded threats. The drop's bracketed interpretations are the drop's claims, presented without evidence.
text: James Comey @Comey. Special Agent Andrew McCabe stood tall over the last 8 months, when small people were trying to tear down an institution we all depend on. He served with distinction for two decades. I wish Andy well. I also wish continued strength for the rest of the FBI. America needs you. Q !UW.yye1fxo 01/29/18 (Mon) 23:47:54 No.80. JC Tweet Translation: Special Agent Andrew McCabe stood tall over the last 8 months [DO NOT TALK], when small people [SHEEP] were trying to tear down an institution we all depend on [COVER]. He served with distinction for two decades [WE OWN YOU & YOUR FAMILY]. I wish Andy well [187]. I also wish continued strength for the rest of the FBI [GENERAL THREAT TO OTHERS]. America needs you [ACTIVATE SLEEPER CELLS]. Q
flags: The 'translation' bracketed meanings are unverified claims made by the Q drop, not statements by Comey

description: Photograph of a United States flag on a flagpole, waving against a clear blue sky and backlit by the sun, which glows through the star field. Filename 'FREEDOM.jpg'. A widely circulated stock-style patriotic image; attached to Q drops as a symbolic image with no text.

Low-resolution, blurry screenshot of a Discord message posted under the username 'Microchip', dated September 14, 2017. The message shares a Breitbart London article link about Hungary's border wall cutting illegal immigration by over 99 percent. 'Microchip' is a pseudonymous online figure later claimed in reporting to have been involved in early QAnon posting; the screenshot itself shows only this one message.
